comments.author: Lena
comments.body:
Heres what the Japanese Wiki says...Take note articles are also submitted by players not developers

"Attack speed is different by a weapon
Gun >> ax> bow> spear sword => cane knife club> throw"

This is exactly what it says word for word which is very confusing but according to what it says is Gun takes the longest then the speed is
" => " which is equal to greater than cane knife and clubs with throwing as the least time. Why would they say greater than equal to probably because the speed is so small its hard to measure

Now there are TWO VERY important pieces of information missing here..
HOW MUCH FASTER are we talking seconds,miliseconds, or nano seconds? is the difference over 2 seconds is it less than miliseconds?
IS THIS speed at maxed ranks (ex.R20 Throwing vs. R20 Sniping or the base ranks meaning(all ranks at 0) for this argument lets assume its maxed although we have no idea

In my experience I have all techs in the game its not nearly 2 or 3 seconds difference thats too slow and I cant humanly compute how fast a nanosecond is so its not that small so I will say its about a second faster. so lets do math

there are 6 weapons so lets take one second and divide it between the number of weapon to determine how much faster according to the list

Knife=.8 miliseconds faster
sword/spear/cane=.6 miliseconds faster(remember they said cane greater than equal to sword so the margin so small ill just group them)
bow= .4 miliseconds faster
Axe= .2 miliseconds faster
Gun= 0 miliseconds faster

CONCLUSION

So sword is .6 miliseconds faster...and heres my conclusion after all of this... this is a very small margin but still faster none the less do I think its faster to the point to make a major difference? kind of sorta but with people spamming wings its not going to matter anyway as you will be missing most of your normal hits. Also if people were to move around constantly with a long range weapon like CPC the gun would actually hit more often than sword in some cases just really depends on how you fight.

So just fight with the weapon you like the best and enjoy the game they all even out and stop arguing about this because its really stupid just PLAY THE GAME

Have a nice day :)
